scenario_summary: Customer needs to access an account without access to registered contact methods and requests a refund without an order number.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Darnell Robinson and I'm 43. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.

Hello Darnell, I understand how frustrating it is to be locked out of your account when you need assistance. For security reasons, I cannot access account details using only a name. To verify your identity, could you please provide your full billing address and the last four digits of the card used for the purchase?
Okay, that makes sense. My address is 123 Maple Street, Springfield, and the card ends in 4492.

Thank you for providing those details. I have located your account. Regarding the refund, our 'Account Security & Refund Policy' requires that we verify the specific transaction ID or order number to prevent unauthorized access. Since you don't have the order number, I can search by the date of the transaction. Do you recall approximately when the charge occurred?
I think it was around July 12th. It was for a pair of headphones that never arrived.

I see the transaction here from July 12th for $149.99. Because this involves a non-receipt claim, I have initiated a formal investigation. I have successfully processed the refund to your card ending in 4492, which should reflect in your account within 3-5 business days.
Oh, that's a relief! Thank you so much for helping me get that sorted out.

You're very welcome, Darnell. I have also sent a password reset link to the email on file so you can regain access to your account once you are back at your usual device. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

resolution_summary: Agent verified the customer using billing address and card details, identified the transaction by date, and successfully processed the refund.

judge_scores.justification: The agent expertly handled a high-risk verification challenge by requesting appropriate billing and card details instead of relying solely on the name. Furthermore, the agent grounded decisions in the 'Account Security & Refund Policy' while efficiently utilizing alternative transaction lookup methods to resolve the customer's issue without unnecessary escalation.
